references.text: God's instruction to Moses to make fifty loops on the edge of the outermost tent curtain at one joining, and fifty loops on the edge of the tent curtain at the other joining. This is the original commandment that Exodus 36:17 fulfills.
Parallel description of the loops made for the inner tent curtains of fine linen, with the same pattern of fifty loops on each side for joining.
Earlier instruction about loops for the inner tent curtains, showing the same system of fifty loops to fasten the tent curtains together.
